soft_failures.text: NVIDIA is making waves with its open-source contributions.
Their new Nemotron models are pushing the envelope for what's possible in generative AI, particularly for enterprise applications.
OpenAI is rolling out new tools to help websites express their AI training preferences.
Imagine a website owner being able to specify through a simple tag whether their content can be used to train future AI models, much like robots.txt for web crawlers.
OpenAI also released its Community Safety Report, detailing new protections for teens.

synthesis.claim: The fluctuating funding targets for leading AI labs signal a potential maturation of the AI investment landscape, moving beyond speculative hype towards more grounded, deliverable value propositions.
